description: Speed-to-Lead + Booking Engine v1. Inbound (form / Messenger / missed call) -> SMS+email inside 60s, Messenger drafted for a human -> AI qualification -> booked -> reminders -> no-show recovery -> reactivation -> weekly owner report.

buildSurface.note: GHL workflows and snapshots are UI-only. The public API exposes no create-workflow and no create-snapshot operation (verified 2026-08-19 against 302 registry operations). Everything in workflows[] below is built by hand in the GHL UI from speed-to-lead-snapshot-v1.md, then exported as a snapshot.

configPoints.comment: Everything a new client changes. Client #2 edits only this block -- that is what makes redeploy configuration, not construction. Set as GHL Custom Values so workflow copy never hardcodes a clinic name.

customFields.name: Lead Source Detail
customFields.why: web_form | facebook | missed_call -- drives per-channel reporting

customFields.name: First Touch At
customFields.why: stamped when the first SMS/email leaves; the sub-60s proof

customFields.name: Response Seconds
customFields.why: inbound -> first touch, in seconds. The number on the weekly report.

customFields.name: Treatment Interest
customFields.why: captured by AI qualification; drives which reactivation copy is used

customFields.name: Messenger Thread Id
customFields.why: page-scoped id for the Facebook thread; the only handle a Messenger-only lead has

workflows.name: STL 1 -- First Touch (60s)
workflows.trigger: Inbound webhook / form submit / FB message / missed call
workflows.sla: SMS/email out in <60s; Messenger drafted and queued for a human inside the same 60s

workflows.name: STL 7 -- Weekly Owner Report
workflows.note: Built and tested. GHL cannot aggregate across contacts, appointments and a custom field, so this one lives in n8n rather than the snapshot.

safety.rule: No real SMS or email to a real number from a non-client account. The n8n transport node enforces this; automation/n8n/test/speed-to-lead-smoke.mjs fails the build if sandbox-sink is swapped for a live transport.
safety.verified: 2026-08-19 -- negative test confirmed the swap is caught
safety.messengerRule: Messenger is never sent automatically. Facebook does not permit it on these threads and a ban costs the client every channel at once. The engine drafts the reply and queues it with a deadline; a human sends. speed-to-lead-smoke.mjs fails if a Messenger action ever reports a send.

verification.result: intake: 9/9 scenarios passed, 11/12 nodes exercised, worst case 3 ms of a 60000 ms budget. report: every metric matched the hand-computed fixture. Negative tests confirmed both the live-transport swap and a Messenger auto-send are caught.
